theorems.statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (Ω : Set (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))) (Ψ : WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k) → Rn N) (S : Set (Rn N)) (g : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Ψ Ω → InjOn Ψ Ω → (∀ p ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Ψ p)) → (∀ p ∈ Ω, f (Ψ p) = WithLp.fst p) → MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ Ψ '' Ω → Measurable g → Measurable (fun y ↦ ∫⁻ x in S ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, g x ∂μHE[k]) ∧ ∫⁻ p in Ω ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' S, ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ Ψ p).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet) * g (Ψ p) = ∫⁻ y, ∫⁻ x in S ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, g x ∂μHE[k] ∂volume
